user.title: Set up WatchZone
user.description: Create the WatchZone application entry. Camera providers can be added later.

camera_preload.title: Preloaded Cameras
camera_preload.description: Keep Home Assistant HLS ready only for the selected cameras. This uses server resources even when no card is visible.

data_description.hls_prewarm_cameras: Select up to 12 cameras. Their existing Home Assistant entities and stream workers are reused; no duplicate camera entities are created.

init.title: Diagnostics
init.description: Diagnostic logging is retained only in bounded server memory. Disabling it or restarting Home Assistant clears all records.

data_description.diagnostic_logging: Captures a sanitized, rate-limited WatchZone history for Home Assistant diagnostics downloads. It does not use the recorder database.
